provision.quote: The petitioner has been served with a notice under Section 73 of the CGST Act, 2017 on the grounds inter alia that he had not paid the tax due.

financial_years.quote: dismissing the appeal of the petitioner for the period 2017-18 : 2018-19 and 2019-20 respectively.

defects_argued.quote: Learned counsel has also enclosed a copy of the judgment passed by learned Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in the case of Rakesh Ranjan (supra) as Annexure ‘E’ to the counter affidavit.

outcome.quote: This writ application has no merit. It is dismissed accordingly.
